note: Every token with its final value per mode. Semantic tokens are the ones to use in product UI; primitives are never used directly.

Color/Primary/LightGreen/50.description: The primary brand palette used across interactive elements: CTAs, links, inputs, active states, focus rings.

Color/Primary/Yellow/50.description: The brand secondary palette, used alongside primary green to indicate secondary focus.

Color/Secondary/Purple/50.description: Progress palette. Conveys progress, milestones, and reflective states.

Color/Info/Blue/50.description: Informational palette. Used for neutral information, tips, and informational states.

Color/Success/Green/50.description: Success palette. Conveys positivity, completion, and successful states.

Color/Caution/Brown/50.description: Warning palette. Conveys holding states, warnings, and on-hold states.

Color/Warning/Orange/50.description: Warning palette. Conveys holding states, warnings, and on-hold states.

Color/Error/Red/50.description: Error palette. Conveys negativity, failures, and error states.

Color/Neutral/50.description: Neutral palette. Supporting colors used for backgrounds, text, separators, and modal surfaces.

Color/Dark/50.description: Dark surface palette. Purpose-built for dark mode surfaces with near-black variants.

Color/Shade/White.description: Pure white. Used as a primitive for surfaces and absolute light.

Color/Shade/Off-White.description: Soft off-white. Used as a supporting background tone.

Color/Shade/Black.description: Pure black. Used as a primitive for absolute dark and high-contrast text.

Color/Alpha/White/10.description: White at 10% opacity. For light scrims and subtle overlays on dark images.

Color/Alpha/Black/10.description: Black at 10% opacity. For subtle dividers and shadow tints.

Color/Alpha/Black/50.description: Black at 50% opacity. Used as the canonical modal scrim and full-screen overlay backdrop.

Spacing/0.description: No space. For collapse and reset.

Spacing/2.description: Hairline. Internal spacing on tight controls.

Spacing/4.description: Tight. Between an icon and its label.

Spacing/8.description: Compact. Internal padding on chips and small components.

Spacing/24.description: Sections. Default gap between content sections.

Spacing/64.description: Hero spacing. Top of a page.

Radius/8.description: Default for small components: inputs, chips.

Radius/12.description: Default for medium components: buttons, cards.

Radius/20.description: Used by Safqah brand-aligned cards (v1 carries 20px).

Radius/32.description: Extra large. Reserved for hero containers.

Radius/Full.description: Fully rounded, pills, avatars, circular buttons.

bg/surface.description: Least elevated surface. The canvas behind everything, the base layer at the back of the elevation ladder.

bg/base.description: Mid-elevation surface. The base content area where most page content sits, White in Light mode, mid-dark in Dark. Sits above bg/surface and below bg/elevated.

bg/elevated.description: Most elevated surface. The off-white surface used for any element that needs to clearly elevate above the page, cards, modals, popovers, and prominent floating elements. The default surface when elevation is needed.

bg/inverse.description: Inverse surface. Dark UI on light pages, tooltips, dark snippets, marketing dark-on-light blocks.

bg/overlay.description: Modal scrim and full-screen overlay backdrop.

bg/reverse-overlay.description: Modal scrim and full-screen overlay backdrop.

bg/brand/primary.description: Primary brand background. CTAs and brand-colored surfaces.

text/default.description: Default body text. Highest contrast on light backgrounds.

text/muted.description: Secondary body text. Captions, helper text.

text/brand/primary.description: Brand-colored text. Used for links and brand emphasis.

text/on-brand.description: Text on brand-colored surfaces (e.g. on primary buttons).

border/default.description: Default border. Cards, dividers, input borders at rest.

border/darkmode-divider.description: Default border. Cards, dividers, input borders at rest.

border/strong.description: Strong border. Emphasis or selected state.

border/brand/primary.description: Primary brand border. The strongest brand-colored border, used for selected states, emphasis, and brand-aligned containers.

border/focus.description: Focus ring color. Themed with brand.

border/success.description: Success border. Used on inputs with successful validation.

border/success-subtle.description: Success border. Used on inputs with successful validation.

border/caution.description: Success border. Used on inputs with successful validation.

border/caution-subtle.description: Success border. Used on inputs with successful validation.

border/error.description: Error border. Used on inputs with validation errors.

border/error-error.description: Error border. Used on inputs with validation errors.

icon/default.description: Default icon color. Matches body text.

icon/muted.description: Secondary icons. Inline icons next to muted text.

icon/inverse.description: Inverse icon (on dark or brand backgrounds).

radius/brand.description: Safqah brand-aligned radius. Used on featured cards.

radius/full.description: Fully rounded. Pills, avatars, circular buttons.

bg/brand/lightest.description: Light brand surface. Default light-end brand fill.

bg/brand/darkest.description: Dark brand surface. Default dark-end brand fill (hero / marketing).

bg/brand/darkest-pressed.description: Dark brand surface, pressed state. Deepest brand fill.

bg/brand/primary-subtle.description: Soft brand-tinted background. Used for brand callouts and inline highlights.

radius/default.description: Default corner radius across v2 components. Same value as radius/brand (20px). Reach for this unless a component documents a different radius.

bg/brand/accent-50.description: Lightest brand-tinted surface. Soft highlight on neutral backgrounds.

bg/brand/accent-100.description: Very light brand surface. Subtle brand presence on light backgrounds.

bg/brand/yellow.description: Brand yellow background. Secondary brand surface used alongside the primary brand green to indicate secondary focus.

bg/brand/yellow-subtle.description: Soft brand-yellow background. Used for secondary brand callouts and inline highlights.

border/brand/subtle.description: Very subtle brand-tinted border. Use for cards or inputs where a hint of brand presence is wanted without strong emphasis.

border/brand/muted.description: Quiet brand border. Slightly more visible than subtle, for grouped sections or callouts with brand affinity.

border/brand/accent.description: Visible brand-accent border. Use when a border should clearly read as brand-colored without competing with a CTA.

border/brand/darkest.description: Darkest brand border. The deepest brand-colored border (#387C3F), used for high-emphasis edges on hero or marketing surfaces.

text/brand/darkest.description: Darkest brand text. The deepest brand-colored text (#387C3F), used for high-emphasis text on light surfaces or hero / marketing copy.

icon/brand/darkest.description: Darkest brand icon. The deepest brand-colored icon (#387C3F), used for high-emphasis icons on light surfaces or hero / marketing contexts.

border/progress.description: Progress / milestone border. Used on inputs and containers conveying progress states.

border/progress-subtle.description: Progress / milestone border. Used on inputs and containers conveying progress states.

Font/Size/9.description: Fine print. Below readable threshold for normal copy. Use only for legal disclosures and compliance footnotes.

Font/Family/Base.description: The single canonical font family for v2.0. Replaces v1's 5 redundant aliases (Display/Headline/Body/Title/Caption) that all resolved to the same font.

Font/Size/12.description: Caption / fine print. Lowest size for normal product copy.

Font/Size/14.description: Default body text. Most product copy lives here.

Font/Weight/Regular.description: Normal / regular / plain. Default body weight.

Font/LetterSpacing/Snug.description: Slightly tight tracking. Used for headings and emphasis where Tight is too aggressive.

Font/Size/10.description: Very small. Use only for compliance text and metadata.

Font/Size/11.description: Small. Use sparingly for dense data tables and footnotes.

Font/Size/13.description: Tight body. Between caption and default body.

Font/Size/22.description: Between section title and page title.

Font/Size/48.description: Hero display. Onboarding and landing only.

Font/Size/72.description: Largest size. Onboarding splash / marketing only.

Font/LineHeight/line-height-9px.description: Line height for 9px text. English: 9px × 10/7 ≈ 12.86px. Arabic: 9px × 1.5 = 13.5px (extra space prevents diacritic clipping).

Font/LineHeight/line-height-10px.description: Line height for 10px text. English: 10px × 10/7 ≈ 14.29px. Arabic: 10px × 1.5 = 15px (extra space prevents diacritic clipping).

Font/LineHeight/line-height-11px.description: Line height for 11px text. English: 11px × 10/7 ≈ 15.71px. Arabic: 11px × 1.5 = 16.5px (extra space prevents diacritic clipping).
